title: Technician-B, Heavy Vehicle Driver-A, Light Vehicle Driver-A, Staff Car Driver-A
qualification: Technician-B applicants must have passed SSLC/SSC/Matriculation and possess an ITI, National Trade Certificate (NTC) or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the relevant trade from NCVT. || Candidates must possess a qualification corresponding to the advertised trade. A 10th Pass certificate alone is not sufficient for Technician-B eligibility.
salary: The starting basic pay is Rs. 21,700 per month for Technician-B under Level 3 and Rs. 19,900 per month for driver posts under Level 2, plus admissible allowances. || Selected employees will be governed by the applicable National Pension System or Unified Pension Scheme provisions. URSC/ISRO also provides eligible employees with benefits such as medical facilities, subsidized canteen facilities, leave travel concession and other facilities subject to the prescribed conditions. || The advertised posts are described as temporary but likely to continue. Candidates should not confuse this classification with a short-term outsourced contract.
age_limit: The age limit for Technician-B and all advertised driver posts is 18 to 35 years as on 13 November 2026 .
application_fee: All applicants must initially pay Rs. 500 per application . The recruitment carries a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 100 for applicable candidates, with refunds processed only for candidates who appear in the written examination. || Important: The refundable amount is conditional on appearing in the written examination. Candidates who do not appear in the written test are not eligible for the refund. || Payment is accepted online through the Bharatkosh payment gateway using Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI. Applicable payment service charges are borne by the applicant. || Refunds will normally be made to the original payment method. Candidates should provide correct bank account details for cases where the original refund method fails.
selection_process: The selection process includes initial application screening, a Written Test or Computer Based Test (CBT), and a qualifying Skill Test. For driver posts, the Skill Test is a practical driving assessment. || Initial Screening:Applications will be screened using academic performance and other prescribed parameters. || Written Examination / CBT:Screened-in candidates will appear for the applicable objective examination. || Skill Test:Candidates shortlisted based on written examination performance will be called for a qualifying skill or driving test. || Document Verification:Original educational, experience, reservation and other eligibility documents will be verified. || Final Selection:Selection will follow the prescribed written examination merit and qualifying skill test requirements.
